Title: Login with valid Username And Password
Precondition: Login page is open
Steps: Enter standard_user and secret_sauce, then click Login
Expexted Result: User should be logged in and Products page should open

Title: Login with invalid username
Precondition: Login page is open
Steps: Enter invalid username and valid password, then click Login
Expexted Result: User should not be logged in and error message should be displayed

Title: Login with invalid password
Precondition: Login page is open
Steps: Enter valid username and invalid password, then click Login
Expexted Result: Enter valid username and invalid password, then click Login

Title: Login with empty fields
Precondition: Login page is open
Steps: Leave username and password empty, then click Login
Expexted Result: error message should be displayed

Title: Verify product details
Precondition: User is logged in and on the Products page
Steps: Check any product
Expexted Result: Product image, name, description, price and Add to cart button should be displayed

Title: Open product details page
Precondition: User is logged in and on the Products page
Steps: Click on any product name
Expexted Result: Selected product's details page should open

Title: Sort products by Name A to Z
Precondition: User is on the Products page
Steps: Select Name (A to Z) from the dropdown
Expexted Result: Products should be sorted alphabetically from A to Z

Title: Sort products by Name Z to A
Precondition: User is on the Products page
Steps: Select Name (Z to A) from the dropdown
Expexted Result: Select Name (Z to A) from the dropdown

Title: Sort products by Price Low to High
Precondition: User is on the Products page
Steps: Select Price (low to high)
Expexted Result: Products should be sorted from lowest price to highest price

Title: Sort products by Price High to Low
Precondition: User is on the Products page
Steps: Select Price (high to low)
Expexted Result: Products should be sorted from highest price to lowest price

Title: Add a product to cart
Precondition: User is logged in and on Products page
Steps: Click Add to cart for any product
Expexted Result: Product should be added to the cart and cart count should increase to 1

Title: Add multiple products to cart
Precondition: User is on Products page
Steps: Click Add to cart for two or more products
Expexted Result: All selected products should be added and cart count should show the correct number

Title: Remove product from Products page
Precondition: A product has been added to cart
Steps: Click Remove for the added product
Expexted Result: Product should be removed and cart count should decrease

Title: View added product in cart
Precondition: At least one product is added to cart
Steps: Click the cart icon
Expexted Result: Cart page should open and the selected product should be displayed

Title: Remove product from Cart
Precondition: Cart contains at least one product
Steps: Open Cart  click Remove
Expexted Result: Selected product should be removed from the cart

Title: Continue shopping from Cart
Precondition: Cart page is open
Steps: Click Continue Shopping
Expexted Result: User should be redirected to the Products page

Title: Verify Twitter link in footer
Precondition: User is logged in and on the Products page
Steps: Scroll to the bottom of the page. Click the X icon.
Expexted Result: Twitter page should open correctly.

Title: Verify Facebook link in footer
Precondition: User is logged in and on the Products page
Steps: Scroll to the bottom of the page. Click the Facebook icon.
Expexted Result: Facebook page should open correctly.

Title: Verify LinkedIn link in footer
Precondition: User is logged in and on the Products page
Steps: Scroll to the bottom of the page.Click the LinkedIn icon.
Expexted Result: LinkedIn page should open correctly.

Title: Verify Checkout button
Precondition: User is logged in and cart contains at least one product
Steps: Open Cart and click Checkout
Expexted Result: User should be redirected to the Checkout Information page

Title: Checkout with valid information
Precondition: Cart contains at least one product
Steps: Enter valid First Name, Last Name and Postal Code click Continue
Expexted Result: Checkout Overview page should be displayed

Title: Checkout with all fields empty
Precondition: Checkout Information page is open
Steps: Leave all fields empty click Continue
Expexted Result: Appropriate validation message should be displayed

Title: Checkout with empty First Name
Precondition: Checkout Information page is open
Steps: Leave First Name empty, enter Last Name and Postal Code click Continue
Expexted Result: First Name validation message should be displayed

Title: Checkout with empty Last Name
Precondition: Checkout Information page is open
Steps: Enter First Name and Postal Code, leave Last Name empty ? click Continue
Expexted Result: Last Name validation message should be displayed

Title: Checkout with empty Postal Code
Precondition: Checkout Information page is open
Steps: Enter First Name and Last Name, leave Postal Code empty click Continue
Expexted Result: Postal Code validation message should be displayed

Title: Checkout with empty cart
Precondition: User is logged in and cart is empty
Steps: Open Cart.  Click Checkout.  Enter valid First Name, Last Name and Postal Code.  Click Continue.  Click Finish.
Expexted Result: User should not be able to place an order when the cart is empty.
